correctness.rationale: The formula follows by expanding both signs on each disjoint edge pair and also by subtracting adjacent from all edge pairs. The exact gcd is forced by empty/one-edge/two-disjoint-edge negative signings; all sixteen residues follow from a valid period-16 binomial congruence. The first zero has an explicit seven-edge negative star; an eight-edge negative graph gives W=2. For n=8, two separate exhaustive integer recurrences agree on all 268,435,456 frequencies, corroborated by 2,048 direct sums and full Parseval, certifying rank 247,967,776 and least nonzero magnitude 2.

The first singular order (eight) gives a natural full-census cutoff with a genuine kernel of 20,467,680 dimensions, not obtainable from an unsigned matching count; an exact pseudoinverse norm quantifies recoverability.
